Two use cases — same platform

A sports retail chain — 8 stores

The network manager receives Google reviews from all 8 stores but has no time to read them. The national average score is 4.1 — everything seems fine.

After 3 months of TextIQ + PredictIQ analysis:

  • Store 4 has 73% of negative mentions on checkout wait time — invisible in the overall score
  • 12% of customers mentioning 'out of stock' do not return within 60 days (average PredictIQ score: 68%)
  • The Bordeaux store has the best 'satisfaction' emotion score on sales advice — its practices are rolled out to other locations
  • 3-month trend: frustration score dropped from 34% to 21% after targeted training

A home décor e-commerce site

FAQ

What data do I need to send?

A CSV or Excel export of your reviews, tickets or emails is enough. No technical setup required. We also retrieve Google Reviews and Trustpilot on request.

Can you compare several stores at the same time?

Yes — multi-location comparison is one of TextIQ's core features. Each store gets its own score and ranking vs the network average.

How long before I see results?

The first analysis is delivered within 48 hours. Trends become significant from the second monthly analysis.

You have customer reviews sitting in Google or Trustpilot?

Send us your last 100 reviews — we send back a full analysis in 48 hours. Free. No credit card.
